content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no exclusivity obligation binds Sparkling.

- **§2 (Grant of Licence):** the licence to Sparkling is expressly "non-transferable and non-exclusive" — a grant characteristic, not a dealing restriction on us.
- **§3 (Restrictions on Use):** limited to copying, assignment, reverse engineering and third-party protection; no bar on procuring competing software or services.
- **§10 / §11 (Maintenance and Fees):** maintenance is a renewable one-year service with no sole-source commitment for support, Improvements, new releases or future modules.
- Full-document searches for "exclusive", "sole", "requirements", "third part" and "compet" surfaced only the non-exclusive escrow licence (p0115), the exclusive-remedy clause (§15) and non-exclusive jurisdiction (p0146) — none creating exclusive dealing.

We retain freedom to buy from other suppliers, so the preferred position is met and no redline was proposed.
